chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Members of the mission band
summary: He lists the group: Fairbanks Wilson on trombone, Albert and Henry Brooks, and trumpeter Alvin Ersher.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Then with the band, you said you played like My Old Kentucky Home. But where did you play? At the hall?

Yeah, that's where we practiced. Sometimes they'd let us go out on the street and play under the lights at night. I remember one tune, 'Buckle Call Rag' I took a solo on that, the first trombone solo I ever took.
Do you remember, Jay C., what the instrumentation was? You said there was 5 of you.
I'll do my best. We were talking about that today. We had another trombone player.
What was his name?
His name was Fairbanks Wilson.
So in a 5-piece band you had two trombones?
I don't know how many pieces we had. Something like that.
Clarinet -
Two trombones, clarinet -
His name was (Albert) Brooks on clarinet.
And Alvin (Ersher) trumpet.
Alvin (Ersher)
Yes, he was the trumpet player.
That would be 5. Was there more than that?
There was two brothers that was playing. (Albert) Brooks and Henry Brooks.
What about drums?
I don't remember who we had or if we had drums. Tuba or
anything like that?
No.... I don't remember that.
Was there any other competing band? You said that the missionaries got together and formed groups. Had there been another group before or was there another group at the same time?
No.
